definitions.explanation: Being the only one of its kind. Nothing else exists in the same category.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生存者|せいぞんしゃ}→生存者：21241_seizonsha⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。

⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: She is the only one on the team who can speak Japanese.

notes:
{唯一|ゆいいつ} emphasizes that something is the only one of its kind, with absolutely no alternatives or equivalents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: the only ~ ({唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧, the only method)
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦{無二|むに}→無二：24982_muni⟧: one and only, absolutely unique
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{例外|れいがい}→例外：03798_reigai⟧: the sole exception

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たった→たった：00403_tatta⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: only one (casual, spoken)
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}: only, sole (formal, written)
- ⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧: unique, original (focuses on distinctiveness)
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: the one and only (literary)

USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and a no-adjective. More formal and emphatic than ⟦たった→たった：00403_tatta⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧. Common in written language and formal speech.
